verdict.rationale: Dover is a hosted recruiting SaaS, and whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public source repository or an open-source license. The API, webhooks, MCP server, and Markdown docs are integration and openness-adjacent features, not readable source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
